Yah nahar 400,000 acre se adhik kshetra ko apne command me leti thi, yaani itni zameen tak paani pahuncha sakti thi. Kisi ek varsh me isse sabse adhik sinchai 1912-13 me 164,838 acre ki hui; 1921-22 me 153,204 acre sinchit hua tatha isse pehle ke paanch varshon ka saalana ausat 145,052 acre tha. Nahar ka paani zyadatar dhan ki fasal par kharch hota tha, ganna par bhi kaafi hota tha, jabki gehu tatha anya rabi fasalon ke liye yah utna zaroori nahi maana jaata tha, sirf Hathiya ki varsha fail hone par. Exam point: Patna-Gaya nahar 1877 me khuli tatha ise Son tatha Punpun ke beech ki zameen ki sinchai ke liye banaya gaya tha; 1912-13 me isse 164,838 acre sinchit hua, jo sabse adhik tha.

qe: How long was the light railway which was opened from Fatuha to Islampur, linking the interior of the Barh subdivision with the East Indian Railway system?
qh: बाढ़ अनुमंडल के भीतरी क्षेत्र को ईस्ट इंडियन रेलवे प्रणाली से जोड़ने के लिए फतुहा से इस्लामपुर तक खोली गई लाइट रेलवे कितनी लंबी थी?
e: Barh tatha Bihar subdivision ke andar ke kshetra ko East Indian Railway system se jodne ke liye do light railways khuli thin. Fatuha se Islampur tak jaane wali light railway 27 mile lambi thi, jabki Bakhtiyarpur se Bihar hokar Rajgir tak jaane wali light railway 32.5 mile lambi thi; Bakhtiyarpur-Bihar line 1903 me khuli thi tatha baad me ise Rajgir tak badhaya gaya. Light railway yaani halki patari wali chhoti railway, jo kam kharch me dehati kshetra ko mukhya rail-marg se jodti hai. In dono lines ke alawa Patna-Gaya railway line bhi jile ko uttar se dakshin kaatti thi. Is tarah jile ke uttari hisse me East Indian Railway poorab se pashchim jaati thi tatha do light railways tatha Patna-Gaya line uttar se dakshin jaati thin, jisse lagbhag har bazaar tak pahunchna saral ho gaya. Exam point: Fatuha-Islampur light railway 27 mile tatha Bakhtiyarpur-Bihar-Rajgir light railway 32.5 mile lambi thi; Bakhtiyarpur-Bihar line 1903 me khuli tatha baad me Rajgir tak badhayi gayi.

qe: The canal system in Patna was under the Canal Superintending Engineer, Son Circle, whose headquarters were at which place?
qh: पटना की नहर व्यवस्था सोन सर्कल के कैनाल सुपरिंटेंडिंग इंजीनियर के अधीन थी, जिनका मुख्यालय किस स्थान पर था?
e: Patna jile ki nahar vyavastha Canal Superintending Engineer, Son Circle ke niyantran me thi, jinka mukh-yalaya Arrah me tha. Sthaniya star par nahar ka prabhari adhikari Executive Engineer, Eastern Son Division the, jo Dehri me tainat the. Unki zimmedari nahar ke rakhar-khaw tatha sinchai ke kaam-chalane ki thi, jabki sinchai ki aay yaani water-rates vasool karne ke liye ek alag establishment rakha gaya tha. Nahar ke paani ka hisaab theek se ho, iske liye sinchit kshetra ko blocks me baanta gaya tha; har block ki saari zameenon ki lease is tarah tay ki jaati thi ki sabki avadhi ek hi saal me poori ho, tatha koshish ki jaati thi ki har saal barabar kshetra ki leases samapt hon. Exam point: Patna ki nahar vyavastha Son Circle ke Canal Superintending Engineer ke adhin thi, jinka headquarters Arrah me tha, tatha nahar ka rakhar-khaw tatha sinchai-karya Dehri me tainat Executive Engineer, Eastern Son Division dekhte the.

qe: Above Digha the Ganga could be navigated only by small steamers of light draught, mainly because its upper waters were diverted for what purpose?
qh: दीघा से ऊपर गंगा में केवल हल्के ड्राफ्ट वाले छोटे स्टीमर ही चल सकते थे, मुख्यतः क्योंकि उसके ऊपरी भाग का पानी किस उद्देश्य से मोड़ दिया गया था?
e: Ganga is jile ki mukhya jal-marg thi, lekin uske upari bhaagon ka paani sinchai ke liye mod diye jaane ke karan Digha se upar ki or yah nadi sirf halke draught yaani kam gehrai me chalne wale chhote steamers se hi chali ja sakti thi. Indian Navigation and Railway Company tatha Rivers Steam Navigation Company mil kar Ganga par niyamit steamer seva chalati thin. Bade stern-wheel yaani peeche pahiye wale steamers Goalundo tatha Digha ke beech chalte the tatha Digha me hi company ka sthanik mukhya karyalaya tha. Yatri tatha maal Digha par ek steamer se doosre par transfer kiye jaate the; wahan se chhote steamers Ganga par Buxar tak tatha Gogra par Barhaj tak jaate the. Exam point: Ganga ke upari bhaag ka paani sinchai ke liye mode jaane ke karan Digha se upar sirf halke draught ke chhote steamers chal sakte the; bade stern-wheel steamers Goalundo tatha Digha ke beech chalte the tatha Digha me company ka sthanik head office tha.

qe: A long-term lease of a canal block could be granted only when not less than how much per cent of the cultivators having fields within the block signed their names against the measured areas?
qh: नहर के किसी ब्लॉक की दीर्घकालीन लीज़ तभी दी जा सकती थी, जब ब्लॉक के भीतर के खेतों वाले कम से कम कितने प्रतिशत किसान नापे गए रकबे के सामने अपने नाम पर हस्ताक्षर कर दें?
e: Kisanon ko nahar ka paani manngi yaani application par diya jaata tha tatha saal ko teen mausamon - garmi, kharif tatha rabi - me baanta gaya tha; har mausam ke liye ek tithi tay hoti thi tatha us mausam ki lease ya permit sirf usi avadhi ke liye laagu hoti thi. Iske alawa long-term leases bhi hoti thin, jo das saal tak ki avadhi ke liye thodi kam dar par di jaati thin. Aisi lease sirf unhi compact blocks ke liye di jaati thi jinki siimayein spasht hon tatha jahan leased zameen ko bahar ki unleleased zameen se alag pehchana ja sake. Block ki naap ho jaane ke baad lease ko Divisional Canal Officer antim roop se sweekar karta tha; usse pehle block ke kheton wale kam se kam 85 pratishat kisanon ko apne naam tatha naapi gayi zameen ke raqbe ke saamne hastakshar karna padta tha. Exam point: Nahar ki long-term lease tabhi di jaati thi jab block ke 85 pratishat se kam nahi kisan apne naam tatha raqbe ke saamne hastakshar kar dein.

qe: Which of these places was a steamer station of the Patna district, where the steamers plying on the Ganga used to halt?
qh: इनमें से कौन-सा स्थान पटना जिले का स्टीमर स्टेशन था, जहाँ गंगा में चलने वाले स्टीमर रुकते थे?
e: Patna jile me Ganga par steamers ke sthan yaani steamer stations Hardi Chhapra, Marufganj, Fatuha, Baikantpur, Barh tatha Mokameh par the. Buxar tatha Barhaj is jile se bahar the - Buxar tak chhote steamers Ganga par tatha Barhaj tak Gogra nadi par jaate the; Goalundo Bengal me tha, jahan se bade stern-wheel steamers Digha tak aate the. Son nadi par nav-sanchaar ruk-ruk kar hota tha tatha vyapar ki drishti se bahut kam mahatvapurna tha; anya nadion me varsha ke atirikt paani nahi rehta tha, isliye wahan naav ya steamer ka chalna sambhav nahi tha. Exam point: Patna jile ke Ganga-tat ke steamer stations Hardi Chhapra, Marufganj, Fatuha, Baikantpur, Barh tatha Mokameh the, jabki Buxar aur Barhaj is jile se bahar the.

qe: For the hot weather season lease of canal water, that is for 26 March to 27 June, what rate per acre was charged?
qh: नहर के पानी की गर्मी के मौसम की लीज़, यानी 26 मार्च से 27 जून तक, प्रति एकड़ किस दर पर दी जाती थी?
e: Sinchai ke paani ke paanch rates the. Rabi season ki lease 26 October se 25 March tak Rs 3-8-0 prati acre par, garmi ke mausam ki lease 26 March se 27 June tak Rs 7-8-0 prati acre par, isi avadhi me har ek watering yaani paani dene par Rs 2-8-0, kharif season ki lease 25 June se 25 October tak Rs 5-0-0 prati acre par, tatha das saal ki lease block kshetra ke liye 25 June se 25 March ke beech kisi bhi fasal par Rs 4-8-0 prati acre par milti thi. In rupaye ke aankdon me pehla ank rupaye, doosra ank aane tatha teesra ank paisa darshata hai, isliye Rs 7-8-0 ka matlab saat rupaye aath aane. Rabi tatha garmi ki lease paani manngi par milti thi tatha rate asli sinchit kshetra par lagta tha. Exam point: Nahar ke paani ke paanch rates the - rabi Rs 3-8-0, garmi Rs 7-8-0 prati acre (ya har watering par Rs 2-8-0), kharif Rs 5-0-0 tatha das saal ki block lease Rs 4-8-0 prati acre.

qe: During the dry season on the Son, boats of more than how many maunds burden could not proceed up-stream, though in the rains boats of five or six hundred maunds occasionally sailed up the river?
qh: सोन नदी पर सूखे मौसम में कितने मन से अधिक बोझ वाली नावें धारा के विरुद्ध ऊपर की ओर नहीं जा सकती थीं, जबकि वर्षा में पाँच-छह सौ मन की नावें भी कभी-कभी नदी में ऊपर जाती थीं?
e: Son nadi par nav-sanchaar ruk-ruk kar hota tha tatha vyapar ki drishti se bahut kam mahatvapurna tha. Garmi ke mausam me paani kam gehre hone ke karan bees maund se zyada bhaar wali naav up-stream yaani dhara ke virudh nahi ja sakti thi; varsha me aane wali tez baadhein bhi badi naavon ko rok deti thin, halanki kabhi-kabhi paanch sau se chhe sau maund tak ki naav bhi Son me upar tak chali jaati thi. Jile ki anya nadion me nav-sanchaar lagbhag sambhav nahi tha, kyunki garmi tatha jade ke mausam me woh lagbhag sookhi rehti thin tatha varsha me turant bhar kar turant utar jaati thin. Aisi haalat me gaon ke log baans ke halke dhanche ko ulte matke yaani mitti ke bartanon par tairate hue ek janghiye yaani raft bana kar nadion ko paar karte the. Exam point: Son nadi par garmi ke mausam me bees maund se zyada bhaar wali naav up-stream nahi ja sakti thi, jabki varsha me paanch sau se chhe sau maund tak ki naav bhi kabhi-kabhi upar jati thi; anya nadion me log baans tatha ulte matkon wale raft se paar karte the.

qe: Which village officials were appointed with the approval of the majority of the cultivators to help in measurements and to see that canal water was properly distributed over the leased area?
qh: नाप-तौल में सहायता करने तथा लीज़ क्षेत्र में नहर का पानी ठीक से बंट रहा है यह देखने के लिए बहुमत किसानों की स्वीकृति से किन ग्राम-अधिकारियों की नियुक्ति होती थी?
e: Nahar ke paani ko theek se baantne tatha naapne ke kaam me madad ke liye gaon ke prabhavshali logon, jinhe lambardar ya gaon ka mukhiya kaha jaata tha, ki niyukti sambandhit bahumat kisanon ki sweekriti se ki jaati thi. Unka kaam tha naap-taul me sahayata karna, vividh joton ke kisanon ke naam report karna tatha yah dekhna ki leased kshetra me paani theek se baanta gaya. In sevaon ke liye unhe paani ke sabhi assessments par Re 1-9-0 per cent yaani ek rupaya nau aane prati sau rupaye ka commission diya jaata tha. Rabi tatha garmi ki lease me paani manngi par diya jaata tha tatha rate us asli kshetra par lagta tha jahan sinchai hui, chahe application me kam ya zyada raqba likha ho. Exam point: Lambardar yaani gaon ke mukhiya kisanon ki sweekriti se niyukt hote the tatha paani ki assessment par unhe Re 1-9-0 prati sau rupaye ka commission milta tha.

qe: The first-class ferries on the Ganga at Hardi Chhapra, Sherpur and Daudpur, all managed by the Patna District Board, lay along which road?
qh: गंगा पर हरदी छपरा, शेरपुर तथा दाउदपुर की प्रथम श्रेणी की नौका-सेवाएँ, जिनका प्रबंधन पटना जिला बोर्ड के पास था, किस सड़क पर स्थित थीं?
e: Patna tatha Bankipore ke bahar jile ki mukhya ferries Ganga par thin. Dinapore subdivision me Hardi Chhapra, Sherpur tatha Daudpur ki ferries Dinapore-Maner road par sthit thin, jabki Barh subdivision me Bakhtiyarpur, Barh, Athmal Gola tatha Mokameh ki ferries thi. Yah sab first-class ferries kahi jaati thin tatha inka prabandh Patna ke District Board ke haath me tha; ferry yaani nadi paar karane ki niyamit naav-seva. Nadi paar karne ke liye chhote naavon ka istemal hota tha; ghodon ya bail-gadiyon ko le jaane ke liye kuch naavon par baans ya takhton ki chhat bana kar usme thodi sookhi ghaas bichha di jaati thi, jabki yatriyon ko bina chhat wali naavon me paar karaya jaata tha. Exam point: Dinapore subdivision ki Hardi Chhapra, Sherpur tatha Daudpur ki first-class ferries Dinapore-Maner road par thin tatha Barh subdivision me Bakhtiyarpur, Barh, Athmal Gola aur Mokameh ki ferries thi; sabka prabandh Patna ke District Board ke paas tha.

qe: The two largest private canals of the district lay twelve miles south-east of Bihar town; the main stream of which river deserted its original bed and took to the canal, ruining the tract towards Asthawan?
qh: जिले की दो सबसे बड़ी निजी नहरें बिहार शहर से बारह मील दक्षिण-पूर्व में थीं; किस नदी की मुख्य धारा अपना मूल पाट छोड़कर नहर में उतर गई, जिससे अस्थावाँ की ओर का क्षेत्र बर्बाद हो गया?
e: Niji nahrein yaani pains Bihar ke anya jilon me bhi thi, lekin unki tulna me Patna jile me yah zyada aam thin tatha mukhyatah Bihar subdivision me paayi jaati thin. Yah pains Gaya se Patna me aane wali un nadion se nikalte the jinme garmi ke mausam me paani bahut kam ya bilkul nahi hota tha, par varsha me kinare-kinare bhar jaati thin. Nadion ke kinaron par se nahrein nikaal kar paani kheton me baanta jaata tha; varsha me nadion me baadh aane par yah nahrein bhar jaati thin, aur agar September me varsha na ho to nadion me bandh bana kar paani rok kar pains me moda jaata tha; ek pain bhar jaane par bandh kaat kar paani agli dam tak beh jaata tha. Jile ke do sabse bade pain Bihar shahar se barah mile dakshin-purb me the. Inki ek badi kami tab saamne aayi jab Sakri nadi apne mool paat ko chhod kar nahar me utar gayi, jisse baadh ka paani kaabu me karna mushkil ho gaya tatha Asthawan ki or ka kshetra pehle milne wale paani se vanchit ho gaya, jisse wahan ke kisanon ki samriddhi nast ho gayi. Exam point: Jile ke do sabse bade private canals Bihar shahar se barah mile dakshin-purb me the tatha Sakri nadi ke apne mool paat ko chhod kar nahar me utar jaane se Asthawan ka kshetra paani se vanchit ho kar barbaad ho gaya.

qe: The ghats of Bankipore and Patna were let in one lot with the ghats of the opposite bank by which officer, who distributed the rent between the District Boards of Saran and Muzaffarpur and the Patna Municipality?
qh: बांकीपुर तथा पटना के घाट किस अधिकारी द्वारा सामने वाले किनारे के घाटों के साथ एक ही लॉट में ठेके पर दिए जाते थे, जो किराए को सारण तथा मुजफ्फरपुर के जिला बोर्डों एवं पटना नगरपालिका के बीच बाँटते थे?
oe: The Chairman of the District Board
e: Bankipore tatha Patna ke ghat - Digha, Mahendru, Ranighat, Pathrighat, Adrak, Marufganj, Damriahi tatha Jethuli - nadi-tat par sthit the. Yah ghat saamne wale kinare ke ghaton ke saath ek hi lot me theke par diye jaate the tatha yah kaam Patna ke Magistrate karte the. Theke se milne wali aay yaani kiraye ko woh Saran tatha Muzaffarpur ke District Boards tatha Patna Municipality ke beech baantte the. Ghaton ke alawa jile ke naav-vyapaar ka bada hissa bhi Ganga par hi tha; naavon ko chalane ke liye bamboo punt-poles yaani baans ke lambe dande se dhakka diya jaata tha tatha ek bhaari patwar se disha niyantrit ki jaati thi. Exam point: Bankipore tatha Patna ke ghat saamne wale kinare ke ghaton ke saath ek hi lot me Patna ke Magistrate dwaara theke par diye jaate the tatha unki aay Saran aur Muzaffarpur ke District Boards tatha Patna Municipality me baanti jaati thi.

qe: An ahar is an U-shaped or rectangular reservoir; embankments were built on how many of its sides, the highest bank being at the end where water would ordinarily emerge?
qh: अहर एक U-आकार या आयताकार जलाशय होता था; इसकी कितनी भुजाओं पर बांध बनाए जाते थे, जिसमें सबसे ऊँचा बांध उस सिरे पर होता था जहाँ से पानी सामान्यतः बाहर निकलता था?
e: Ahar ek U-aakar ya aayatakar talaab hota tha, jise pain ya nikaas ki disha me bane khand-bhand se paani milta tha. Iske teen kinaron par bandh yaani embankments banaye jaate the; sabse uncha bandh us sire par hota tha, jahan se paani aam taur par bahar nikalta. Ek kinara khula chhoda jaata tha, jisse paani aakar ahar me bharta tha. Agar chhota ahar kisi nikaas-khand ke aar-paar bana ho to sabse gehre sire par ek patla sa cut bana diya jaata tha, jisse zarurat se zyada paani nikal jaye; bade ahar me isi kaam ke liye ek weir yaani paani ka bahav niyantrit karne wala bandh bana diya jaata tha, jisse paani bah kar niche wale doosre ahron ko bhi bharta tha. Ahar ka paani weir ke raste kheton tak jaane wali channels me jaata tha tatha paani kam hone par use latha, karin ya chanr jaisi yantron se uncha kiya jaata tha. Exam point: Ahar ke teen kinaron par bandh hote the aur ek kinara khula rehta tha; sabse uncha bandh us sire par hota tha jahan se paani bahar nikalta tha tatha paani kam hone par use uncha karne wale yantra kaam aate the.

qe: Which places were the principal centres of the boat-building industry of the district, whose broad-beamed country boats were used in the shallowest water?
qh: जिले में नाव बनाने के उद्योग के मुख्य केंद्र कौन-से स्थान थे, जिनकी चौड़ी पेंदी वाली देसी नावें सबसे कम गहरे पानी में भी चलती थीं?
oe: Patna city, Banka Ghat and Fatuha
oh: पटना शहर, बांका घाट तथा फतुहा
e: Jile me istemal hone wali naav sabhi desi banawati thin tatha unhe banane ke mukhya kendra Patna shahar, Banka Ghat tatha Fatuha the. Yah naav aam taur par chaudi (broad in the beam) hoti thin, isliye kam gehre paani me bhi chal sakti thin; badi naavon par chhat jaisa deck hota tha, jo andar rakhe maal ko mausam se bachaata tha. Har naav me ek mast hota tha, jispar hawa anukul hone par kapde ka sail yaani pawan-chalit pat chadhaya jaata tha. Dhara ke saath yaani down stream jaate samay naavon ko peeche se baans ke lambe dandon se dhakka diya jaata tha tatha ek bhaari patwar se disha di jaati thi; wapsi ki yaatra, jo aam taur par nadi ke sabse kam paani ke samay hoti thi, rassiyon se naav ko kheench kar up-stream ki jaati thi. Exam point: Jile me naav banane ke mukhya kendra Patna shahar, Banka Ghat tatha Fatuha the; dhara ke saath jaane par baans ke dandon se tatha wapsi par rassi se kheench kar naav chalayi jaati thi.

qe: Wells irrigated only 73,133 acres in the district, yet they were regarded as almost as important as pains or ahars; which kind of produce was almost always irrigated from wells?
qh: जिले में कुओं से केवल 73,133 एकड़ की सिंचाई होती थी, फिर भी उन्हें पेन या अहर के लगभग बराबर महत्वपूर्ण माना जाता था; किस प्रकार की उपज लगभग हमेशा कुओं से ही सिंचित की जाती थी?
e: Kuen yaani wells Patna jile me teen tarah se kaam aate the - uttar ki unchi zameen ki sinchai me, tal kshetra ki rabi fasalon me tatha gaon ke aas-paas wali zameen me. Bagwani ki paidawar yaani garden produce lagbhag hamesha kuon se hi sinchit ki jaati thi tatha kuen se nikalne wali paani ki chhoti-chhoti channels ka ek jaal-sa bana hota tha, jo paani ko bagwane ke ploton tak pahunchata tha. Kuon se sinchit kshetra sirf 73,133 acre tha, lekin kisanon ke ashcharyajanak parishram tatha is tarah sinchit fasal ki keemat ke karan kuen pains ya ahron ke lagbhag barabar mahatvapurna sadhan maane jaate the. Exam point: Patna jile me kuon se sinchit kshetra keval 73,133 acre tha, lekin bagwani ki paidawar lagbhag hamesha kuon se hi sinchit ki jaati thi tatha kuen isliye pains ya ahron ke lagbhag barabar mahatvapurna maane jaate the.

qe: There were altogether how many miles of postal communication in the district, with 77 post offices which together delivered over 62 lakh postal articles?
qh: जिले में कुल कितनी मील की डाक-व्यवस्था थी, जिसमें 77 डाकघर थे तथा जिनसे मिलाकर 62 लाख से अधिक डाक-वस्तुएँ वितरित हुईं?
e: Patna jile me kul mila kar 522 mile lambi postal vyavastha thi tatha 77 post offices the. 1922-23 me in dwarfaa 62,78,625 postal articles yaani letters, postcards, packets tatha akhbaar baante gaye. Usi varsh money orders yaani dhan-aadesh ke roop me Rs 49,06,527 ke money orders jari kiye gaye tatha Rs 61,72,590 ke bhugtan kiye gaye; savings bank me 17,830 khaate the, jinke kul jama Rs 10,78,831 the. Iske alawa jile me 23 telegraph offices the, jinhone us varsh 74,149 messages bheje tatha 92,940 messages praapt kiye. Yeh sankhya dikhati hai ki jila sanchar ke sadhano se kaafi achhi tarah juda hua tha. Exam point: Jile me 522 mile postal vyavastha tatha 77 post offices the; 1922-23 me 62,78,625 postal articles baante gaye tatha 23 telegraph offices ne 74,149 message bheje aur 92,940 message praapt kiye.

qe: Within the gherwa or outer embankment, which was about four feet high, there was a series of smaller embankments known by what name, the last of all being the ails round individual fields?
qh: लगभग चार फुट ऊँचे घेरवा यानी बाहरी बांध के भीतर छोटे-छोटे बांधों की श्रृंखला किस नाम से जानी जाती थी, जिसके सबसे अंदर अलग-अलग खेतों के चारों ओर बने ऐल होते थे?
e: Kheton se paani bahar nikalne se rokne wali bandhon ki shrinkhla ko genrabandi kaha jaata tha. Isme sabse bahari bandh gherwa kahlata tha, jo lagbhag chaar foot uncha hota tha; uske andar chhote-chhote bandh hote the, jine genra kaha jaata tha; tatha sabse andar har ek khet ke chaaron or bane aam bandh ails kahlate the. In bandhon ka rakhar-khaw pain ya ahar ke rakhar-khaw jitna hi zaroori tha, kyunki inhi ke karan kheton me paani ruk paata tha. Is vyavastha ka niyantran, sinchai ki anya vyavasthaon ke saath, aam taur par zameendar ke haath me hota tha. Exam point: Kheton me paani rokne wali bandhon ki shrinkhla genrabandi kahlati thi, jisme bahari bandh gherwa lagbhag chaar foot uncha hota tha, andar ke chhote bandh genra tatha har khet ke chaaron or ke bandh ails kahlate the.

qe: The District Board maintained 157 miles of metalled and 455 miles of unmetalled roads; how many miles of village roads were maintained by the Local Boards in addition?
qh: जिला बोर्ड 157 मील पक्की तथा 455 मील कच्ची सड़कें बनाए रखता था; इसके अतिरिक्त स्थानीय बोर्डों द्वारा कितनी मील ग्रामीण सड़कें बनाए रखी जाती थीं?
e: Jile me District Board ke paas 157 mile pakki yaani metalled tatha 455 mile kachchi yaani unmetalled sadkon ka prabandh tha, jabki 24 mile metalled sadak Public Works Department ke charge me thi. Iske alawa Local Boards dwaara 756 mile lambi gaon ki sadkein banaye rakhi jaati thin. Pachas saal pehle jile me provincial tatha district roads ki kul lambai sirf 416 mile thi, isliye sadkon ke vistar me bahut sudhar hua. Pachas saal pehle ki in sadkon me Patna se Gaya jaane wali ek first-class sadak bhi shamil thi, jo ab nahi rahi; woh zameen Patna-Gaya railway ke liye le li gayi tatha railway line ke paas wala rasta aam taur par gaadiyon ke chalne laayak nahi hai, isliye ab sadak se Gaya jaane ke liye Bihar tatha Nawada hokar jaana padta hai. Exam point: District Board 157 mile metalled tatha 455 mile unmetalled sadkein rakhta tha, 24 mile metalled sadak Public Works Department ke paas thi tatha Local Boards 756 mile gaon ki sadkein banaye rakhte the; pachas saal pehle kul sadkein sirf 416 mile thi.

qe: Which irrigation device had a long beam working on an upright forked post as a fulcrum, weighted at one end with a log or stone and carrying a cone-shaped bucket named kunri at the other?
qh: किस सिंचाई यंत्र में एक लंबा बीम किसी सीधे दो-शाखा वाले खंभे पर टेक के रूप में काम करता था, जिसके एक सिरे पर लकड़ी या पत्थर का भार तथा दूसरे सिरे पर कुनरी नाम की शंकु-आकार की बाल्टी लगी होती थी?
e: Latha ek saadhaaran lekin karagar yantra tha, jisse paani kheton tak jaane wali channel tak uncha kiya jaata tha. Isme ek lamba beam yaani shah-tir kisi seedhe do-shakhay wale post yaani sahaare ke upar takulle ki tarah kaam karta tha, jise fulcrum kaha jaata hai. Beam ke ek sire par lakdi ka lambe tukde ya patthar jod kar bhaar lagaya jaata tha tatha doosre sire par rassi se ek shanku-aakar yaani cone jaisi balti latki hoti thi, jise kunri kaha jaata tha. Kisan rassi ko neeche khinchta tha, jisse kunri paani me doob jaati thi; phir fulcrum par lage bhaar ke karan kunri khud upar utth jaati thi tatha paani channel me khaali kar diya jaata tha. Yah kriya baar-baar dohrayi jaati thi. Exam point: Latha ek lever-numa yantra tha, jisme ek lamba beam do-shakhay post par takulle ki tarah kaam karta tha, ek sire par bhaar tatha doosre sire par kunri naam ki cone-aakar balti lagi hoti thi.

qe: The first of the two great historic roads of the district ran by the Ganga from Kothwar Ghat through Maner, Dinapore, Patna, Barh and Daniapur towards Monghyr; it was metalled from Maner up to which place?
qh: जिले की दो महान ऐतिहासिक सड़कों में पहली गंगा के किनारे-किनारे कोठवार घाट से मनेर, दीनापुर, पटना, बाढ़ तथा दानियापुर होकर मुंगेर की ओर जाती थी; यह मनेर से किस स्थान तक पक्की थी?
e: Jile ki do mahaan aitihasik sadkein thi. Pehli sadak Ganga ke kinare-kinare Kothwar Ghat se Maner, Dinapore, Patna, Barh tatha Daniapur hokar Monghyr tatha Bhagalpur ki or jaati thi; yah Bihar se Sakrigali hokar Bengal jaane wala prachin marg tha tatha Maner se Fatuha tak pakki yaani metalled thi, poori lambai me ek sundar tatha pedon se saaya-daar sadak thi. Doosri prachin sadak Phulwari, Naubatpur tatha Bikram hokar Kanpa tak jaati thi tatha wahan se Son ke samanantar chal kar Gaya jile me pravesh karti thi; yahi Patna se Dilli jaane wala purana marg tha. Mufassal yaani dehati kshetra ki sabse achhi sadkein Patna se Fatuha hokar Ilsa tatha Patna se Maner aur Bihta hokar Bikram tak jaati thin. Exam point: Ganga ke kinare wali prachin sadak Maner se Fatuha tak metalled thi; doosri mahaan aitihasik sadak Patna se Dilli jaane wala marg tha, jo Phulwari, Naubatpur tatha Bikram hokar Kanpa se Gaya jile me jaata tha.

qe: Which device, most commonly used for irrigating from wells in the west of the district, brought up a large leather bucket by means of a pair of bullocks running down an inclined plane dug on the far side of the well?
qh: जिले के पश्चिम में कुओं से सिंचाई के लिए सबसे अधिक प्रयोग होने वाला कौन-सा यंत्र चमड़े की बड़ी बाल्टी को बैलों की जोड़ी द्वारा कुएँ के दूसरी ओर खोदी गई ढलवाँ सतह पर दौड़ाकर ऊपर लाता था?
e: Jile ke pashchim bhag me kuon se sinchai ke liye sabse zyada bullock-run ka istemal hota tha. Isme ek badi chamde ki balti ek rassi se bandhi hoti thi; yah rassi ek do-shakhay post par lage pulley yaani ghumaav wale pahiye se hokar jaati thi tatha doosre sire par bailon ki jodi ke juye se bandhi hoti thi. Kuon ke door wale kinare par ek dhalwan yaani inclined plane khod diya jaata tha; jab balti paani se bhar jaati thi to bail us dhalwan par neeche ki or daudte the tatha balti upar aa jaati thi. Balti channel me khaali karne ke baad bailon par se bhaar hat jaata tha tatha woh dhalwan se wapas upar chad jaate the; phir balti dobara kuon me utaari jaati thi tatha kriya dohrayi jaati thi. Exam point: Bullock-run me chamde ki badi balti ko bailon ki jodi, kuon ke doosri or bane dhalwan par daud kar upar kheenchti thi; pashchimi Patna me kuon se sinchai ka yahi sabse aam tarika tha.

qe: Which water-lifting device was a scoop shaped like a dug-out canoe cut in half, its broad open end resting on the water channel and its pointed end dipped into the reservoir?
qh: कौन-सा जल-उत्थापक यंत्र आधी काटी गई डगआउट नाव जैसा दिखता था, जिसका चौड़ा खुला सिरा पानी की नाली पर रखा जाता था तथा नुकीला सिरा जलाशय में डुबोया जाता था?
e: Karin ek paani uncha karne wala scoop tha, jo aadhe kaate hue dug-out yaani ek hi lakdi ke tane ko khod kar banayi gayi naav jaisa dikhta tha. Yah aam taur par lakdi ke ek hi tukde se banta tha, lekin lohe ke karin bhi kam nahi the. Iska chaura khula sira kheton tak jaane wali channel par rakha jaata tha tatha nukila sira talaab ya jalashay ke paani me daala jaata tha; paani uncha karne ke liye upar ek lever lagaya jaata tha, jiske sire par bhaar hota tha. Karin aur chanr se paani bahut uncha nahi kiya ja sakta tha, isliye jalashay ka paani neeche ho jaane par ek hi paani ko uncha karne ke liye kai-kai yantra ek ke baad ek lagane padte the. Chanr dhuns wali chhat wali ek baans ki tokri hoti thi, jiski dono or ki rassiyaan do aadmi pakadte the; woh tokri ko pehle peeche jhulate the tatha phir tezi se paani me neeche laate the. Exam point: Karin aadhe kaate dug-out ki tarah ka scoop tha, jiska chaura sira channel par tatha nukila sira paani me rehta tha, jabki chanr do aadmiyon dwaara jhulayi jaane wali baans ki tokri thi; dono se paani kam unchai tak hi chadh sakta tha.

qe: The cost of the rough and ready irrigation works of the district varied from four to twelve annas an acre; when the Tikari estate was under the Court of Wards, what percentage of the rental of irrigated villages was calculated as necessary for maintenance and repair?
qh: जिले के साधारण सिंचाई-कार्यों की लागत प्रति एकड़ चार से बारह आने तक थी; जब टिकारी एस्टेट कोर्ट ऑफ वार्ड्स के अधीन थी, तब सिंचित गाँवों के किराए का कितना प्रतिशत रखरखाव तथा मरम्मत के लिए आवश्यक माना गया था?
e: Jile ke ahar, pain tatha usi tarah ke saadhaaran sinchai karyaon ki laagat bahut kam thi; survey tatha settlement ki karyavahi me yah paaya gaya ki kharch chaar se barah aane prati acre ke beech tha. Tikari estate jab Court of Wards yaani us vyavastha ke adhin thi, jisme na-balig ya asamarth malik ki riyasat ka prashasan adalat tatha sarkari karyapalak sambhalte hain, tab ganna kiya gaya ki sinchit gaon ke kiraye yaani rental ka saat pratishat hissa sinchai karyaon ke rakhar-khaw tatha marammat par kharch karna zaroori tha. Raiyat ke apne kheton tak jaane wale cuttings, unme paani bharne ke lifting arrangements tatha pain me paani rokne wala bandh aam taur par raiyat khud banate the. Exam point: Jile me sinchai karyaon ki laagat chaar se barah aane prati acre thi tatha Tikari estate ke Court of Wards ke daur me sinchit gaon ke rental ka saat pratishat hissa rakhar-khaw aur marammat par kharch karne ka anumaan lagaya gaya tha.

qe: Gold and silver embroidery of two kinds, known as kamdani and zardozi, was carried on in the Chauk and Khwaja Kalan quarters of Patna city by about how many men?
qh: कमदानी तथा जरदोजी नाम की दो प्रकार की सोने-चाँदी की कढ़ाई पटना शहर के चौक तथा ख्वाजा कलाँ मुहल्लों में लगभग कितने लोगों द्वारा की जाती थी?
e: Patna shahar ke Chauk tatha Khwaja Kalan thanon me sone-chandi ki kadhai ka kaam hota tha, jisme lagbhag 1,000 aadmi lagte the; thoda kaam Bihar shahar me bhi hota tha. Kamdani tatha zardozi do tarah ki kadhai thi, jo mukhyatah topiyon tatha ghode aur hathi ke saazon par ki jaati thi. Is kadhai ki khyaati Lucknow ya Banaras ke kaam jitni nahi thi. Kadhai me lagne wali sone-chandi ki taar tatha panna yahin bana liye jaate the, lekin zyadatar sone ka dhaaga Banaras tatha United Provinces se aata tha. Kadhai ke alawa Patna me sone-chandi ke aabhushan bhi bante the. Exam point: Patna ke Chauk tatha Khwaja Kalan thanon me kamdani aur zardozi kadhai me lagbhag 1,000 aadmi kaam karte the tatha yah mukhyatah topiyon aur ghode-hathi ke saazon par ki jaati thi.

qe: Stone-cutting was carried on in which quarter of Patna city, where sandstone locally called Mirzapuri stone was brought down by river in rough-hewn slabs from Bindhachal and Chunar?
qh: पटना शहर के किस मुहल्ले में पत्थर काटने का काम होता था, जहाँ मिर्जापुरी पत्थर कहलाने वाला बलुआ पत्थर बिंधाचल तथा चुनार से नदी के रास्ते कच्ची सिल्लियों में आता था?
e: Patna shahar ke Marufganj me pathar kaatne ka kaam hota tha. Isme mukhyatah balua pathar lagta tha, jise sthanik roop se Mirzapuri pathar kaha jaata tha; yah Bindhachal tatha Chunar se nadi ke raste moti silon me laaya jaata tha. Granite yaani ek kathor chattan wala pathar Sasaram tatha Monghyr se bhi aata tha, lekin kam matra me; yah zyada sakht hota tha, isliye isse bane sil yaani masalon par ghisi jaane wali sil tatha jauta yaani haath ki chakki zyada daam par bikte the. Pathar se mukhyatah Hindu devtaon ki moti-moti murtiyan, curry-stones, haath se peesne wale patthar, okhli, kumhar ke chak tatha pathar ki platein aur pyale banti thin. In vastuon ki maang Patna ke sabhi bhaagon se bani rehti thi tatha anya jilon me bhi bheji jaati thin. Exam point: Patna ke Marufganj me pathar kaatne ka kaam hota tha, jahan Bindhachal tatha Chunar se Mirzapuri balua pathar nadi ke raste aata tha tatha Sasaram-Monghyr se granite.

qe: In Patna city the hakkaks or lapidaries, who carved small pieces of crystal and pebbles into magmas for setting in rings, necklaces and amulets, belonged to which community?
qh: पटना शहर के हक्काक यानी रत्न-तराश, जो क्रिस्टल तथा कंकड़ के छोटे टुकड़ों को तराश कर अंगूठी, हार तथा तावीज़ में जड़ने योग्य मगमा बनाते थे, किस समुदाय के थे?
e: Patna shahar tatha uske aas-paas ratn-tarash ka kaam bahut kam hota tha. Iska ek hi pramukh kaam tha crystal yaani sphatik tatha kankad ke chhote tukdon ko tarash kar polish karna, jisse chhoti-chhoti magmas naam ki silaiyan banti thin; yah silaiyan anguthi, haar ya tavez me jadne ke kaam aati thin. Crystal tatha kankad mukhyatah Monghyr tatha Bhagalpur ki pahadiyon se aate the. Patna me kaam karne wale hakkaks yaani ratn-tarash sabhi Musalman the, jo peedhiyon se isi vyavasay me lage hue the. Thoda kaam chhah-kone wale taweez tarashne ka bhi hota tha, jin par Kuran ki aayatein khodi jaati thin; inhe rog tatha nazar jaisi buri shaktiyon se bachane wala manaa jaata tha. Bihar tatha uske aas-paas ratn-tarashon ke kuch parivar the, par unke paas aajeevika ke liye koi doosra vyavasay bhi hota tha. Exam point: Patna ke hakkak yaani ratn-tarash sabhi Musalman the tatha woh Monghyr-Bhagalpur ki pahadiyon se aaye crystal tatha kankad ko tarash kar anguthi-haar me jadne yogya magmas banate the.

qe: A monograph on wood-carving noted that the old carved pillars on the houses along the road from Bankipore to Patna were mostly made of which wood, though sisoo and paisor were also sometimes used?
qh: काष्ठ-नक्काशी पर लिखे एक निबंध में कहा गया कि बांकीपुर से पटना जाने वाली सड़क के मकानों के पुराने नक्काशीदार खंभे मुख्यतः किस लकड़ी के बने थे, हालाँकि शीशम तथा पैसार भी कभी-कभी प्रयोग होते थे?
e: Bankipore se Patna tak phaile makanon ki kataar me puraane lakdi ke nakkashi ke jo avshesh bache the, unse pata chalta tha ki pehle ka kaam aaj ke kaam se kaafi behtar tha. Yah nakkashi sadkon tatha chhaton ko sahara dene wale khambhon, architraves tatha brackets par ki jaati thi. Iskaam me mukhyatah teak yaani sagwan ki lakdi lagti thi, kabhi-kabhi sisoo tatha paisor bhi. Pehle bahut se khambhe pahle turner ke yantra par ghumaye jaate the tatha uske baad chatur kaarigar unhe tarash kar nakkashi karte the. Aaj jab makan ka malik puraane khambhon ko badalta hai to turner ka kaam chhod diya jaata hai; isliye naye khambhe chaar-kone rehte hain, bhaale hi un par nakkashi theek se kar di gayi ho. Yah nakkashi Lahore, Dilli tatha Agra ke karigaron ke kaam se tulna nahi kar sakti, tatha Bankipore-Patna road par bane naye makanon me to nakkashi bilkul hi nahi hai. Exam point: Bankipore se Patna ke puraane nakkashi wale khambhe mukhyatah sagwan yaani teak ki lakdi ke bane the, jinme kabhi-kabhi sisoo tatha paisor bhi milti thi, tatha pahle khambhon ko turner par ghumane ke baad tarasha jaata tha.

qe: Patna, with Cuttack, Murshidabad and Monghyr, formed one of the principal centres of which art in the province?
qh: पटना, कटक, मुर्शिदाबाद तथा मुंगेर के साथ प्रांत में किस कला के प्रमुख केंद्रों में एक था?
e: Patna, Cuttack, Murshidabad tatha Monghyr ke saath is kshetra me sone-chandi ke sunaron ki kala ke pramukh kendron me gina jaata tha. Sone-chandi ke aabhushan mukhyatah Patna shahar me bante the, lekin mufassal yaani dehati kasbon tatha lagbhag har bade gaon me bhi sunar milte the. Sone ke aabhushan ladki ke dahej ka sabse mehnga hissa hote the; Rajput tatha Babhan jaise samuday ke purush sone ka haar tatha bhujband pehente the, jabki sampann Goala ya Dhobi apni sampannta dikhane ke liye sone ke kundal, haar, bhujband ya kangan pehente the. Jo log sone ke aabhushan nahi kharid sakte the, woh chandi ke aabhushan lagate the; madhya varg ke log dahej me chandi ke bartan ka ek set - pan-daan, attar ki tray, phool-daan tatha gulaab-jal ki bottle ek tray ke saath - dete the, tatha zyada sampann log isme ghoda, hathi, chandi ki tanjan ya palki, raj-dand, gada, chhadiyaan tatha bhale bhi jodte the. Exam point: Patna, Cuttack, Murshidabad tatha Monghyr sone-chandi ke sunaron ki kala ke pramukh kendra the, jahan aabhushan Patna shahar me tatha mufassal kasbon aur bade gaon me bante the.

qe: The yearly outturn of the braziers of Patna city was valued at Rs 50,000 and their iron work at over Rs 50,000; the making of which article was a speciality of the blacksmiths of Patna?
qh: पटना शहर के बर्तन बनाने वालों का वार्षिक उत्पादन 50,000 रुपये तथा लोहे का काम 50,000 रुपये से अधिक आँका गया था; किस वस्तु का निर्माण पटना के लोहारों की विशेषता थी?
e: Patna shahar me kai bhar-bhandariya yaani bhaanjon aur loharon ka kaam hota tha. Bhaanjon ke patra yaani peetal ke bartan saal bhar me lagbhag Rs 50,000 ke bante the; yah bartan poori tarah kaam-chalau hote the tatha un par sajawat ya nakkashi ka prayas bahut kam hota tha. Lohar ke kaam ki keemat bhi saal bhar me Rs 50,000 se adhik aanki gayi thi tatha loha se pakshee rakhnay wale pinjare yaani iron bird-cages banana Patna ke loharon ki khaas visheshata thi. Iske alawa Patna shahar me chaabak tatha jute ka chhota vyavasay tha. Bihar subdivision me hookah ke naichas yaani naliyan banana khaas visheshata thi. Baaki anya udyog chhote the tatha sirf sthanik zaruraton ko poora karte the. Exam point: Bhaanjon ka saal bhar ka utpadan Rs 50,000 tatha lohar ka kaam Rs 50,000 se adhik aanka gaya; loha ke pinjare yaani iron bird-cages banana Patna ke loharon ki visheshata thi tatha hookah ke naichas Bihar subdivision ki.

qe: Coal, kerosene oil, iron and steel, salt, wheat and flour, rice, gunny-bags and cotton piece-goods were among the principal what of the district?
qh: कोयला, मिट्टी का तेल, लोहा तथा इस्पात, नमक, गेहूँ तथा आटा, चावल, जूट की बोरियाँ एवं सूती कपड़ा जिले की प्रमुख क्या थीं?
e: Patna jile me aane wali pramukh vastuein yaani imports the - koyla, mitti ka tel, loha tatha ispat, namak, gehu aur aata, chawal, jute ki boriyan tatha suti kapda. Iske viparit jile se bahar jaane wali pramukh vastuein yaani exports the - chana tatha dalen, phal aur sabziyan, alsi, khali, cheeni tatha gehu. Is prakar jile se zyadatar khadyanaj aur unse bane maal tatha khed wale kachche maal bahar jaate the, jabki taiyar maal aur khanizi tel-yantrana ke saadhan aate the. Vyapar ka yah chitra dikhata hai ki jila mukhyatah krishi pradhan tha tatha taiyar maal ke liye anya kshetron par nirbhar tha. Exam point: Koyla, kerosene, loha-ispat, namak, gehu-aata, chawal, jute ki boriyan tatha suti kapde jile ke pramukh imports the, jabki chana-dalen, phal-sabziyan, alsi, khali, cheeni tatha gehu pramukh exports the.

qe: What share of the piece-goods, gunny-bags and salt imported into the district came by river, while only one-eighth of the kerosene oil was imported by river?
qh: जिले में आयात होने वाले कपड़े, जूट की बोरियों तथा नमक का कितना हिस्सा नदी के रास्ते आता था, जबकि मिट्टी के तेल का केवल आठवाँ हिस्सा नदी से आयात होता था?
e: Nadi ke raste aane wale aayaton ka hissa seemit tha - kapde, jute ki boriyan tatha namak ka chauthai hissa tatha kerosene tel ka aathwan hissa nadi se aata tha, baaki ayaton ka nadi se aana bahut kam tha. Nadi ke raste bahar bheji jaane wali vastuein bhi bahut kam thin, sirf chana-dalen tatha gehu. Ganga ke us samay ke mukhya marg hone ke dinon ki tulna me nadi-vyapar ka yah patan Patna tatha Barh ke vyapar-kendron ke patan ka bada karan maana jaata hai. Iske alawa railway companies beech ke sthanon ke liye jo kiraya leti thin, woh Calcutta tak ke through kiraye ke anupat me nahi tha; isliye maal ko seedha Calcutta book karana Patna tak rail se lana aur phir nadi se neeche bhejne se sasta padta tha, jisse Patna me maal laane wale chhote vyapari bhi ab maal seedha Calcutta bhejne lage. Exam point: Kapde, jute ki boriyan tatha namak ka chauthai hissa tatha kerosene ka aathwan hissa nadi se aata tha; nadi-vyapar ke patan ne Patna tatha Barh ke vyapar-kendron ke patan me bada yogdan diya.

qe: While the principal trading castes of the district were Telis, Agarwalas and the various mercantile castes collectively called Baniyas, the river transport was mostly in whose hands, road transport being with the Goalas and Kurmis?
qh: जिले की प्रमुख व्यापारिक जातियाँ तेली, अग्रवाल तथा सामूहिक रूप से बनिया कहलाने वाली व्यापारिक जातियाँ थीं, जबकि नदी का परिवहन मुख्यतः किनके हाथ में था तथा सड़क का परिवहन गोअला और कुर्मी करते थे?
e: Patna jile ka vyapar mukhyatah Teli, Agarwala tatha anya vyaparik jat kar rahi thi, jinhe samuhik roop se Baniya kaha jaata tha. Nadi ka parivahan mukhyatah Musalmanon, Tiyars tatha Mallahon ke haath me tha, jabki sadak ka parivahan mukhyatah Goalas tatha Kurmis karte the. Patna ke alawa jile ke anya mahatvapurna bazaar Dinapore, Bihar, Barh, Mokameh, Islampur tatha Ailsa the. Patna khud province ke sabse bade anaaj-marts yaani anaj mandiyon me se ek tha, jahan anya kshetron ka anaaj aakar bikta tha tatha aage bheja jaata tha. Exam point: Nadi ka parivahan Musalmanon, Tiyars tatha Mallahon ke haath me tha, sadak ka Goalas aur Kurmis ke, tatha vyapar mukhyatah Teli, Agarwala tatha Baniya jatiyon ka tha; Patna province ka bada anaaj-mart tha.

qe: Only one cattle fair was held in the district, at which place, attracting about 5,000 persons, while people generally obtained their cattle and horses from the fairs at Sonpur and Barahpur?
qh: जिले में केवल एक पशु-मेला लगता था, किस स्थान पर, जिसमें लगभग 5,000 लोग आते थे, जबकि लोग सामान्यतः अपने मवेशी तथा घोड़े सोनपुर और बरहपुर के मेलों से लेते थे?
e: Patna jile me lagne wale melon me sabse bada mela Rajgir ka tha, jo har teen saal me lagta tha; iske alawa koi anya mela bada mahatvapurna nahi tha. Jile ka ekmatra pashu-mela Bihta me lagta tha, jisme lagbhag 5,000 log aate the. Aam taur par log apne mavashi tatha ghode Saran jile ke Sonpur tatha Shahabad ke Barahpur me lagne wale melon se lete the. Bihta me lagne wale pashu-mela ke saath hi har saal ek krishi-pradarshani bhi hoti thi, jisme Patna District Board bhi yogdan deta tha tatha jise Imperial tatha Provincial Funds se mavashiyon ke inaamon ke liye anudan milta tha. Iske alawa Bikram thane ke Ainkhan Bazar me bhi ek pashu-mela lagta tha. Exam point: Jile ka ekmatra pashu-mela Bihta me lagta tha, jisme lagbhag 5,000 log aate the tatha jiske saath har saal krishi-pradarshani hoti thi; mavashi-ghode mukhyatah Sonpur tatha Barahpur ke melon se liye jaate the.

qe: Which seer of 80 tolas, with metal weights that were stamped, was in use in the chief centres of trade, while outside Patna and Dinapore the kachcha seer varied from 44 to 84 tolas?
qh: किस सेर यानी 80 तोले का, मुहर लगे धातु के बाँटों के साथ, मुख्य व्यापार-केंद्रों में प्रयोग होता था, जबकि पटना तथा दीनापुर के बाहर कच्चा सेर 44 से 84 तोले तक बदलता था?
e: Mukhya vyapar-kendron me 80 tole ka seer, jise pakka seer kaha jaata tha, prachalit tha tatha uske baante dhatu ke bane hote the tatha un par muhar lagi hoti thi. Lekin Patna tatha Dinapore ke bahar zyadatar tolai kachcha seer se hoti thi, jo kai gandi ka gunaj maana jaata tha; ek gandi chaar tole ke barabar hoti thi, tatha is tarah kachcha seer 44 se 84 tole tak badalta tha. Bahut baar wazan ke liye sirf patthar ka ek tukda hi kaam me laaya jaata tha, jis par koi muhar nahi hoti thi tatha jiska koi nishchit wazan nahi hota tha; isse beimaani ke mauke khule the. Isi tarah paseri, jo paanch seer ke barabar maani jaati thi, paanch se saat seer tak badalti thi. Sunaron tatha dawa-saz vyapariyon me wazan ka kram tha - 8 rali ki ek masha, tatha 12 masha ki ek rupaya. Exam point: Mukhya vyapar-kendron me 80 tole ka pakka seer prachalit tha; gandi chaar tole ki hoti thi tatha kachcha seer 44 se 84 tole tak tatha paseri paanch se saat seer tak badalti thi.

qe: Which local yard of 39 inches, sometimes of 40.5 or 41.75 inches, was commonly employed in the district along with the nambari gaz or English yard of 36 inches?
qh: 36 इंच वाले नंबरी गज यानी अंग्रेजी गज के साथ जिले में सामान्यतः कौन-सा स्थानीय गज, जो 39 इंच का तथा कभी-कभी 40.5 या 41.75 इंच का होता था, प्रयोग किया जाता था?
e: Lambai naapne ke liye jile me do gaz prachalit the. Ek to 36 inch ka English yard tha, jise nambari gaz kaha jaata tha, tatha doosra sthanik gaz tha, jise bara gaz kaha jaata tha; yah 39 inch ka hota tha tatha kabhi-kabhi 40.5 ya 41.75 inch tak bhi. Ghar ke chhote kaam ke liye hath yaani cubit ka istemal hota tha, jo ausatan 18 inch ka hota tha, tatha balisht yaani ek span, jo 9 inch ka hota tha. Dravya naapne ke pramukh maap sabhi seer par aadharit the tatha gallon jaise standard maap bahut kam jagah istemal hote the. Jab liquids badee matra me beche jaate the to unhe aam wazan se tola jaata tha, tatha khudra yaani retail bikri me mukhyatah tin, mitti ya baans ke bartan hi maap ke kaam aate the; mitti ke matke tatha baans ke chunge sabhi prakar ke liquids ke liye vyapak roop se prachlit the. Exam point: Jile me 36 inch ke nambari gaz ke saath 39 inch ka bara gaz prachalit tha, jo kabhi 40.5 ya 41.75 inch tak bhi hota tha; ghar ke kaam ke liye hath tatha balisht tatha liquid naapne ke liye tin, mitti ya baans ke bartan ka istemal hota tha.

qe: The mud dam on the Atehune stream near Sewan, by which the stream is turned out on to the fields, had to be renewed how often?
qh: सेवान के पास अतहुने नाले पर बना मिट्टी का बाँध, जिससे नाले का पानी खेतों में मोड़ा जाता था, कितनी बार नया बनाना पड़ता था?
e: Buchanan ne Sewan jate samay Atehune naam ke nalle ko paar kiya, jo us jagah lagbhag chaudah gaj chauda tha aur jisme thoda sa ruka hua pani tatha gehri mitti ke kinare the. Is nalle par mitti ka ek bandh bana hua tha, jisse nalle ka pani kheton ki or moda jata tha, yaani yah ek aar-sinchai ka prabandh tha. Mitti ke bandh baarish ke prakop tatha pani ke bahav se kat jate the, isliye unhe har saal naya banana padta tha; yahi kaaran hai ki aise bandhon ko har saal dobara banane ka kaam kisans ka ek niyamit karyakram ban gaya. Us samay ke gaon aksar unche sthalon par, purani mitti ki deewaron ke malbe se bane teelon par base hote the, aur kuchh purane mitti ke qile bhi abhi istemal me the. Exam point: Atehune par mitti ka bandh har saal naya banaya jata tha, kyunki baarish tatha bahav usko tod dete the.

qe: On the main line of the East Indian Railway, Patna Junction lay at what distance from Calcutta?
qh: ईस्ट इंडियन रेलवे की मेन लाइन पर पटना जंक्शन कलकत्ता से कितनी दूरी पर पड़ता था?
e: East Indian Railway ki main line Patna jile ke uttari hisse se hokar poorab-pashchim jaati thi tatha jile ke sabse mahatvapurna sthalon ko Calcutta se jodti thi. Is main line par Patna Junction Calcutta se 338 mile door tha; yah line 1862 tak is jile se hokar badhayi ja chuki thi. Station ki doori seedha Calcutta se naapi jaati thi, isliye purane records me sthalon ki doori Calcutta se kitne mile ke roop me likhi milti hai. Patna Junction ke paas hi Digha Ghat, Gulzarbagh tatha Patna City jaise station pade the, jo Patna kshetra ki aavagaman tatha vyapar ke liye mahatvapurna the. Isi line par aage chal kar Bakhtiarpur se Bihar tatha Rajgir ke liye light railway bhi nikli. Exam point: East Indian Railway ki main line par Patna Junction Calcutta se 338 mile door tha; isi line par jaise Mokameh 283 mile tatha Athmalgola 304 mile par sthit the.

qe: On the Patna-Gaya branch of the East Indian Railway, the station which lay 18 miles from Patna Junction was which one?
qh: ईस्ट इंडियन रेलवे की पटना-गया शाखा पर पटना जंक्शन से 18 मील दूर कौन-सा स्टेशन पड़ता था?
e: Patna-Gaya branch yaani East Indian Railway ki woh shakha line, jo Patna Junction se dakshin ki or Gaya ki taraf jaati thi. Is shakha par Patna Junction se aath mile par Poonpoon tatha atharah mile par Taregna station padta tha; Taregna ka sthal aage chalkar apne purane khagol-sambandhi mahatva ke liye bhi jana jata hai. Main line wale station, jaise Neora tatha Khagaul, is shakha par nahi, balki poorab-pashchim jaane wali main line par pade the. Aise branch line kshetra ke gaonon ko seedha Patna tatha Gaya se jodti thi, jisse kisan apni upaj tatha anya saaman aasani se bazaar tatha mandi tak bhej sakte the. Exam point: Patna-Gaya branch par Patna Junction se 18 mile door Taregna station padta tha, jabki Poonpoon aath mile par tha; Neora tatha Khagaul main line ke station the.

qe: On the Bakhtiyarpur-Bihar Light Railway, Nalanda station lay how many miles from Bakhtiarpur?
qh: बख्तियारपुर-बिहार लाइट रेलवे पर नालंदा स्टेशन बख्तियारपुर से कितनी मील दूर पड़ता था?
e: Bakhtiyarpur-Bihar Light Railway Bakhtiarpur se shuru hokar Bihar ho kar aage Rajgir tak jaati thi. Is line ke station tatha unki doori Bakhtiarpur se is prakar ginayi gayi thi - Harnaut saat mile, Pachasa pandrah mile, Soh satrah mile, Bihar Sharif unnis mile, Dipnagar teis mile tatha Nalanda chhabbees mile par pada tha. Isi line par Nalanda ke baad Silao station atthaais mile par tatha aage Rajgir tak ka sthal tha; light railway yaani halki patari wali chhoti railway, jisse dehati kshetra mukhya rail-marg se judta hai. Is tarah Bakhtiarpur-Bihar line Nalanda, Bihar Sharif tatha Silao jaise mahatvapurna sthalon ko Patna tatha Calcutta se jode hue mukhya line se jodti thi. Exam point: Bakhtiyarpur-Bihar Light Railway par Nalanda station Bakhtiarpur se chhabbees mile door tha, jabki Silao atthaais mile par tatha Bihar Sharif unnis mile par pada tha.

qe: A sandy channel about a hundred yards wide, crossed five miles from Ongari, had no stream at all, yet it supplied water for irrigation in what way?
qh: ओंगारी से पाँच मील दूर मिली लगभग सौ गज चौड़ी रेतीली धारा में पानी की कोई धार नहीं थी, फिर भी वह सिंचाई के लिए पानी किस प्रकार देती थी?
oe: By drawing water through a tunnel from the Ganga
By lifting water with swing baskets
By digging a little way into its bed
By building a masonry dam across it
oh: गंगा से सुरंग के रास्ते पानी ला कर
उसके पाट को थोड़ा खोदने पर
उस पर पक्का बाँध बना कर
e: Ongari se lagbhag paanch mile door ek retili dhara milti thi, jo karib sau gaj chaudi thi tatha jisme us samay koi bahav ya dhara nahi thi. Lekin iski ret ke niche paani maujood rehta tha, isliye iske paat ko thoda sa khodne par hi sinchai ke liye paani mil jata tha. Aisi dharaon ka kinara jab unche retile teelon me badal jata hai, tab bhi niche pani bana rehta hai; yahi kaaran hai ki sookhe mausam me bhi kisan aise sthalon se paani nikaal lete the. Isi dhara ke paas wali zameen par soda bhi ubal kar satah par aata tha; efflorescence yaani mitti me ghule namak ka satah par ubal kar aana. Jahan soda sabse zyada tha, wahan us saal chawal ki fasal hui thi. Exam point: Ongari se paanch mile door wali retili dhara me koi dhara nahi thi, par uska paat thoda khodne par sinchai ka paani milta tha; paas ki zameen par soda bhi ubal kar aata tha.

qe: Bakhtiarpur, the junction from which the light railway to Bihar branched off, lay how many miles from Calcutta on the main line of the East Indian Railway?
qh: बख्तियारपुर, जहाँ से बिहार जाने वाली लाइट रेलवे अलग होती थी, ईस्ट इंडियन रेलवे की मेन लाइन पर कलकत्ता से कितनी मील दूर पड़ता था?
e: Bakhtiarpur Barh subdivision me East Indian Railway ki main line par ek station tha, jahan se Bihar Sharif tatha Rajgir jaane wali light railway alag hoti thi. Yah main line par Calcutta se 310 mile door pada tha; iske aas-paas Barh station 299 mile par tatha Athmalgola 304 mile par sthit the. Light railway yaani halki patari wali chhoti railway, jo kam kharch me dehati kshetra ko mukhya rail-marg se jodti hai; Bakhtiarpur se Bihar tak ki yah line 1903 me khuli thi tatha baad me ise Rajgir tak badhaya gaya. Isi tarah Bakhtiarpur junction kshetra ka ek mahatvapurna sthal ban gaya, jahan se gaon ke log tatha vyapari mukhya line pakad sakte the. Exam point: Bakhtiarpur main line par Calcutta se 310 mile door tha tatha yahin se Bihar tatha Rajgir jaane wali light railway alag hoti thi; Barh 299 mile par sthit tha.

qe: On the main line of the East Indian Railway, which station lay between Patna City (Patna Ghat) and Patna Junction?
qh: ईस्ट इंडियन रेलवे की मेन लाइन पर पटना सिटी (पटना घाट) तथा पटना जंक्शन के बीच कौन-सा स्टेशन पड़ता था?
e: East Indian Railway ki main line Patna kshetra me Ganga ke dakshin kinare ke saath-saath chalti thi tatha shahar ke kai mahatvapurna sthalon ko jodti thi. Is line par Patna City yaani Patna Ghat station Calcutta se 333 mile tatha Gulzarbagh 334 mile par pada tha, jabki Patna Junction 338 mile par sthit tha. Isliye Patna City tatha Patna Junction ke beech Gulzarbagh station padta tha, jahan se aage Digha Ghat tatha Dinapore ke station aate the. Gulzarbagh apne afim yaani opium godown ke liye prasiddh tha, isliye yahan rail se hone wali dhoom-dham vyapar ke saath judi hui thi. Stationon ki yah tarteeb Patna shahar ke purane bazaar kshetra tatha nadi kinare wale sthalon ko samajhne me sahayak hoti hai. Exam point: East Indian Railway ki main line par Patna City (Patna Ghat) 333 mile tatha Patna Junction 338 mile par tha, aur in dono ke beech Gulzarbagh station 334 mile par padta tha.

qe: The greater portion of the excise revenue of the district came from the sale of country spirit prepared by distillation from molasses and the flower of which tree?
qh: जिले की आबकारी आय का बड़ा हिस्सा गुड़ तथा किस पेड़ के फूल से बनी देसी शराब की बिक्री से आता था?
e: Jile me abkari yaani excise ki aay ka sabse bada hissa deshi sharab yaani country spirit ki bikri se aata tha. Yah deshi sharab gud yaani molasses tatha mahua ke phool se distil kar ke banayi jaati thi; mahua ka vaigyanik naam bassia latifolia hai tatha yah jile ke jangalon me bahutayat me milta hai. Distillation yaani patlane ki kriya, jisme kisi drav ko garam kar ke uska bhaap alag kar ke thanda kiya jata hai, jisse nasha-padarth ki shudh matra milti hai. 1921-22 me is strot se abkari ki aay nau lakh aath hazaar do sau paisath rupaye thi tatha jile me deshi sharab bikri ke ek sau atharah dukanein licensed thin. Isi tarah mahua jaise sthalya ped-par-ped milne wale padarth abkari ki aay ka bada aadhaar bane hue the. Exam point: Jile ki abkari aay ka bada hissa gud tatha mahua ke phool se bani deshi sharab ki bikri se aata tha; 1921-22 me deshi sharab ki ek sau atharah dukanein licensed thin.

qe: The principal industries carried on in the District Jail at Bankipore were the manufacture of what?
qh: बांकीपुर के जिला कारागार में चलने वाले मुख्य उद्योग किन चीजों का निर्माण थे?
e: Bankipore me jile ka District Jail tha, jisme kaidiyon ke liye alag-alag barracks tatha cells ki vyavastha thi. Yah jail ek sau gyarah kaidiyon ke liye banaya gaya tha, jinme do sau chauranve purush kaidi, atthaais mahila kaidi, sattaais kishor kaidi, chavalis under-trial kaidi tatha das civil kaidi rakhne ki jagah thi. Kaidiyon ko kaam me lagaye rakhne tatha jail ka kharch nikalne ke liye wahan do mukhya udyog chalte the - kalin yaani carpet banane ka kaam tatha sarson ka tel nikalkar uski bikri. Iske alawa Bankipore jail ke aspatal me pachchis kaidiyon ke ilaj ki vyavastha thi; Barh tatha Bihar me alag sub-jail the, jinme chhote-chhote kaidi rakhe jate the. Isi tarah jail ke andar udyog tatha ilaj, dono prabandh dikhate hain ki jail sirf saza dene ka sthal nahi, balki ek swayam-sampurna sanstha ki tarah chalta tha. Exam point: Bankipore ke District Jail me kaidiyon ke mukhya udyog kalin tatha sarson ka tel banane ke the; yah jail ek sau gyarah kaidiyon ke liye banaya gaya tha.

qe: The headquarters of the Eastern Son irrigation division, which looked after the canals of the district, was at which place?
qh: जिले की नहरों की देखरेख करने वाले पूर्वी सोन सिंचाई प्रमंडल का मुख्यालय किस स्थान पर था?
e: Jile me sinchai ke kaam ke liye alag prabhag tatha adhikari the. Public Works Department ke antargat Patna me Superintending Engineer of the Eastern Circle tatha Executive Engineers ka headquarters tha, jinme se ek naye capital ke vishesh karya-prabhag tatha doosra Patna division ka charge dekhta tha. Inse alag, Eastern Son irrigation division ka headquarters Dehri me tha, jahan se Son nadi ke anicut tatha usse nikli nahar tatha distributary ke prabandh ki nigrani hoti thi. Anicut yaani nadi par bana woh pukhta bandh-numa dhancha, jisse pani ka bahav rok kar nahar me moda jaata hai; Patna-Gaya nahar isi system ka hissa hai. Isi tarah jile ki sinchai ka prabandh mukhya line ke engineering-prabhagon ke haath me nahi, balki alag sinchai-prabhag ke paas tha. Exam point: Eastern Son irrigation division ka headquarters Dehri me tha; Sinchai ka yah prabhag Son nadi ke anicut se nikli nahar tatha uski distributaries ko dekhta tha.

qe: Thomas Law's porcelain works in the district drew their earth from a mine on the north face of which hill, one of a ridge of three hills?
qh: जिले में थॉमस लॉ के चीनी-मिट्टी के कारखाने ने तीन पहाड़ियों की श्रेणी की किस पहाड़ी की उत्तरी ढाल पर स्थित खान से मिट्टी निकाली?
e: Jile ke dakshin-pashchim me pahadiyon ki ek nichli shrinkhla thi, jisme teen pahadiyan shamil thin - Dharampur, Nuzera tatha Sopneri; in teenon ke naam wahan ke teen gaonon se aaye the. Inme se Dharampur pahadi ki uttari dhal par ek khan thi, jahan se woh padarth nikala jata tha, jise log chini-mitti yaani porcelain banane wali mitti kehte the. Asal me yah mitti marl thi, jo ek tarah ki chuna-tatha-mitti mili hui parat hoti hai, tatha pahadi me yah ek bahut badi parat ya nest ke roop me milti thi; khudai karne par gaddha kaafi bada ban gaya tha. Isi marl se Thomas Law ke porcelain tatha patthar ke bartan banane wale kaam chalte the, jisse us daur me Patna kshetra me ek nayi tarah ka udyog shuru hua tha. Exam point: Thomas Law ke porcelain ke liye mitti Dharampur pahadi ki uttari dhal wali khan se aati thi; pahadiyon ki is shrinkhla me Dharampur, Nuzera tatha Sopneri teen pahadiyan shamil thi.

qe: For the sale of tari, the fermented liquor of the district, how many shops were licensed?
qh: जिले की खमीरी शराब ताड़ी की बिक्री के लिए कितनी दुकानें लाइसेंस प्राप्त थीं?
e: Abkari yaani excise ka kaam sirf deshi sharab tak seemit nahi tha; jile me tari naam ki khameeri sharab ki bikri ke liye nau sau unasi dukanein licensed thin. Tari yaani tadi, jo tad ke ped ke ras ko khameer lage bina thoda sa sadne par banti hai; yahan tad yaani palmyra ka ped, jiske ras se tadi banti hai. Khameer yaani fermentation ek aisi kriya hai, jisme shakkar sukshm jeevon ki sahayata se sharab tatha gas me badal jaati hai. 1921-22 me tari ki bikri se jile ko do lakh barah hazaar ek sau untalis rupaye ki aay hui, jabki deshi sharab ki bikri ke liye keval ek sau atharah dukanein hi licensed thin. Isi tarah abkari ki aay ke alag-alag strot - deshi sharab, tari, ganja tatha afim - the, jinme se har ek par alag duty tatha license fees lagti thi. Exam point: Jile me tari ki bikri ke liye nau sau unasi dukanein licensed thin, jabki deshi sharab ke liye keval ek sau atharah; tari ke ped ke ras se khameer lage bina banne wali sharab hoti hai.
